styles.name: Glory Trumpet Worship
styles.description: Trumpet-centered worship with warm piano, gentle live drums and a majestic congregational lift.
styles.energy: Restrained opening; gradual expansion toward a powerful concluding chorus.
styles.rhythm: Gentle 4/4 worship groove with restrained percussion and natural rhythmic movement.
styles.drums_percussion: Gentle live drums with restrained percussion, natural movement and cymbal swells; leave room for the trumpet and words.
styles.bass: Smooth bass guitar supporting the worship groove without dominating the trumpet.

instruments.keys: Warm grand piano and sustained atmospheric pads.
instruments.guitar: No featured guitar is specified; retain the trumpet-centered instrumental identity.
instruments.other: Expressive trumpet melodies and a featured trumpet interlude, cymbal swells and layered choir harmonies.

styles.melody_harmony: Original memorable chorus melody and trumpet phrases; vary chord progression and harmonic movement while keeping a reverent congregational character.
styles.vocal_delivery: Expressive, reverent and clearly articulated melodic phrases, with natural congregational responses and layered supporting harmonies; voice is selected separately.
styles.arrangement: Begin with a memorable trumpet or piano introduction. Lead enters over light instrumentation. Gradually expand drums, bass and harmonies. Include an expressive trumpet interlude and finish with a powerful concluding chorus.

lyrics.structure: Meaningful verses, a memorable chorus and natural congregational responses; gratitude, divine greatness, surrender and adoration.
lyrics.vocabulary: Original scripture-informed expressions with clear meaningful language. Do not reproduce existing songs or suggest invented quotations are scripture.

styles.production_mix: Keep expressive trumpet clearly featured, warm piano and pads supportive, smooth bass controlled, live drums gentle and choir harmonies intelligible; retain natural swells and an uplifting final chorus.

introductions: Open with an original expressive trumpet phrase over light piano.
Open with memorable warm piano, introducing a trumpet answer before the lead.
progressions: Use a fresh worship chord progression supporting a clear congregational chorus.
Use an alternate gentle harmonic route with a hopeful resolution into the final chorus.
arrangements: Place a trumpet interlude after the developing chorus before the concluding chorus.
Allow a shorter trumpet transition between sections and a longer expressive interlude before the conclusion.
melody: Develop an original sustained trumpet phrase answered by a memorable chorus contour.
Develop an original shorter trumpet phrase with a contrasting original congregational chorus contour.
lyrical: Lead with gratitude and divine greatness, moving toward adoration.
Lead with surrender and adoration, resolving in hopeful gratitude.

styles.name: Heavenly Fire Worship
styles.description: Reflective worship that builds through live drums, electric guitar and choir into a full-band climax.
styles.mood: Intense, reverent, powerful and progressively uplifting.
styles.energy: Reflective beginning followed by controlled progressive intensity and a full-band worship climax.
styles.rhythm: Live worship rhythm with gradual intensity, controlled drum fills and powerful instrumental builds.
styles.drums_percussion: Strong live drums with controlled fills; build rhythm gradually rather than beginning at full intensity.
styles.bass: Deep bass guitar grounding the live-band worship build.

instruments.keys: Piano, layered keyboards and atmospheric pads.
instruments.guitar: Expressive electric guitar supporting refrains, instrumental breaks and the growing worship arrangement.
instruments.other: Choir harmonies supporting the worship refrain and full-band climax.

styles.melody_harmony: Original strong worship refrain, developing harmonic progressions and clearly shaped melodic declarations; controlled purposeful repetition.
styles.vocal_delivery: Strong, reverent and purposeful declarations with clear refrains and congregational responses; vocal identity is selected independently.
styles.arrangement: Begin reflectively, introduce a strong worship refrain, then build rhythmic intensity through verses, chorus and instrumental sections. Finish with a full-band worship climax; vary when that climax begins.

lyrics.structure: Consecration, surrender, divine presence, spiritual awakening and declarations of faith, using purposeful repetition and congregational responses without excessive duplication.
lyrics.vocabulary: Meaningful original declarations and clear devotional language; avoid empty repeated lines and copies of existing worship songs.

styles.production_mix: Balance expressive guitar, keyboards and deep bass around an intelligible lead and choir; preserve live drum impact, controlled fills and headroom for a progressive full-band climax.

introductions: Begin reflectively with piano and atmospheric pads before the refrain.
Begin reflectively with spacious electric guitar and layered keys before the refrain.
progressions: Use an original developing harmonic progression supporting repeated declarations.
Use a contrasting original harmonic progression that opens out toward the concluding climax.
arrangements: Use a short controlled instrumental break before a later full-band climax.
Let a developing refrain lead into an earlier sustained build, reserving full-band impact for the conclusion.
melody: Create an original strong refrain with measured responding phrases and controlled drum-fill answers.
Create an alternate original refrain contour with deliberate response gaps and varied controlled fills.
lyrical: Develop consecration and surrender into declarations of faith.
Develop divine presence and spiritual awakening into clear congregational declarations.

styles.name: Broken Before You
styles.description: Intimate piano-led worship with warm strings, spacious phrasing and a restrained emotional rise.
styles.mood: Deeply emotional, intimate, humble and reflective.
styles.energy: Intimate and restrained, rising emotionally through the bridge and final chorus without turning into dance music.
styles.rhythm: Slow worship ballad with spacious phrasing and minimal percussion.
styles.drums_percussion: Subtle minimal percussion leaving ample breathing room; do not introduce a dance groove.
styles.bass: Gentle bass supporting piano and strings without crowding reflective phrases.

instruments.keys: Emotional grand piano and atmospheric pads; vary piano voicings while preserving intimacy.
instruments.guitar: No featured guitar is specified; keep grand piano and warm strings central.
instruments.other: Warm strings and restrained supporting harmonies introduced subtly as the song develops.

styles.melody_harmony: Original emotionally clear melodic contours with varied piano voicings, developing chorus melody and warm string support.
styles.vocal_delivery: Intimate, humble storytelling and heartfelt prayer with spacious, emotionally clear phrases and restrained supporting harmonies; voice remains independently selected.
styles.arrangement: Begin with gentle piano, keep the first verse intimate, and introduce subtle strings and harmonies as the song develops. Build toward an emotional bridge and final chorus without becoming a dance song.

lyrics.structure: Meaningful personal storytelling about surrender, dependence on God, forgiveness, healing, trust and heartfelt prayer; develop the chorus naturally.
lyrics.vocabulary: Emotionally clear original words and fitting lyrical imagery, favoring sincerity and meaningful storytelling over generic repeated phrases.

styles.production_mix: Keep piano and lead intimate, strings warm and gradual, pads atmospheric, bass gentle and percussion minimal; allow an emotional bridge and final chorus without a dance-production shift.

introductions: Begin with a gentle spacious grand-piano voicing and intimate lead entrance.
Begin with a gentle closer piano voicing, leaving quiet space before the first verse.
progressions: Keep the slow worship-ballad harmony and vary open piano chord voicings.
Keep the intimate harmonic family and vary close piano chord voicings toward the final chorus.
arrangements: Introduce subtle strings beneath the developing chorus, then rise through the bridge.
Keep strings very light until the bridge, then gently support the emotional final chorus.
melody: Use an original gently rising chorus contour and restrained string response.
Use an original returning chorus contour with a different restrained string arrangement.
lyrical: Tell a clear personal story of forgiveness and healing leading to trust.
Use original imagery of surrender and dependence on God, resolving in heartfelt prayer.

styles.name: Altar Encounter
styles.description: Spacious prayerful worship with atmospheric keys, ambient guitar and room between vocal phrases.
styles.mood: Prayerful, contemplative, reverent and spiritually intense.
styles.energy: Spacious restraint with gradual prayerful intensity, concluding in reverent resolution.
styles.rhythm: Spacious worship rhythm with extended instrumental breathing room. Optional free-time introductory passages may precede the 55–78 BPM body; percussion supports prayer rather than dominating it.
styles.drums_percussion: Restrained supporting percussion; leave extended instrumental breathing room and do not impose a dominant dance pulse.
styles.bass: Deep warm bass supporting sustained chords and spacious phrases.

instruments.keys: Atmospheric pads, sustained keyboard chords and soft piano.
instruments.guitar: Ambient guitar textures supporting the prayerful space.
instruments.other: Instrumental space between vocal phrases and gentle atmospheric transitions; do not add an unrequested dominant ensemble.

styles.melody_harmony: Original prayerful melody, short recurring refrain and gradually moving harmony with room for reflection.
styles.vocal_delivery: Prayerful, contemplative melodic phrasing with deliberate breathing room, clear devotional words and limited purposeful repetition; voice is a separate choice.
styles.arrangement: Begin atmospherically, optionally in free time. Develop a prayerful lead melody and a short recurring refrain, gradually increasing intensity. Leave instrumental space between phrases and conclude with a reverent resolution.

lyrics.structure: Original prayerful expressions of prayer, devotion, holiness, spiritual renewal, consecration and divine presence; short recurring refrain with purposeful limited repetition.
lyrics.vocabulary: Clear original devotional and prayerful language with meaningful pauses; avoid excessive duplication or identifiable borrowed expressions.

styles.production_mix: Give pads, sustained keys, soft piano and ambient guitar space around a clear lead; keep bass warm and percussion restrained, with controlled gradual intensity and a reverent resolution.

introductions: Begin with free-time atmospheric pads and soft piano, then settle into the selected tempo.
Begin with sustained keyboard chords and ambient guitar at a spacious restrained pulse.
progressions: Use slow original harmonic movement beneath the prayerful phrases.
Use alternate original sustained harmonic movement that resolves reverently at the end.
arrangements: Introduce the short recurring refrain early, leaving instrumental breathing room between returns.
Develop the prayerful melody before introducing the short refrain later, preserving space between phrases.
melody: Use an original unhurried prayerful contour with sustained atmospheric answers.
Use a contrasting original prayerful contour with quieter ambient-guitar transitions.
lyrical: Develop devotion and holiness into original prayerful expressions of consecration.
Develop spiritual renewal and divine presence through original contemplative prayer.

styles.name: Intimate Acoustic Worship
styles.description: Gentle fingerpicked guitar worship with soft piano, delicate harmonies and a peaceful natural groove.
styles.energy: Gentle intimate acoustic movement, gradually supported by harmonies, bass and light percussion.
styles.rhythm: Natural acoustic worship groove with restrained percussion and expressive rhythmic movement.
styles.drums_percussion: Subtle shaker and light restrained percussion supporting the fingerpicked acoustic groove.
styles.bass: Warm bass introduced gently as the acoustic arrangement develops.

instruments.keys: Soft piano supporting the acoustic guitar and naturally flowing melody.
instruments.guitar: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar remains the core introduction and instrumental character; include a short acoustic instrumental passage.
instruments.other: Delicate background harmonies supporting the lead without overtaking the intimate arrangement.

styles.melody_harmony: Naturally flowing original melody and meaningful chorus, with varied guitar picking patterns, chord voicings and melodic phrases.
styles.vocal_delivery: Intimate, gentle and heartfelt phrases with naturally flowing melodies and delicate supporting harmonies; the selected voice does not replace the acoustic identity.
styles.arrangement: Begin with acoustic guitar, introduce an intimate lead, and gradually add gentle harmonies, warm bass and light percussion. Include a short acoustic instrumental passage before the final chorus.

lyrics.structure: Personal devotion, gratitude, divine love, trust, spiritual comfort and quiet worship in meaningful verses and a naturally flowing chorus.
lyrics.vocabulary: Simple but meaningful original language, conveying personal devotion and spiritual comfort without generic filler.

styles.production_mix: Keep fingerpicked guitar intimate and clear, piano soft, bass warm, shaker subtle and harmonies delicate; preserve natural acoustic movement and a gentle final chorus.

introductions: Begin with a delicate original fingerpicked guitar pattern before the intimate lead.
Begin with a warmer original fingerpicked guitar introduction and gentle space for the lead.
progressions: Use a fresh acoustic chord voicing route supporting the naturally flowing chorus.
Use alternate gentle guitar chord voicings and melodic phrasing within the same acoustic worship family.
arrangements: Introduce delicate harmonies on the developing chorus, then place a short acoustic passage before the final chorus.
Add bass and light percussion gradually, keeping chorus harmonies sparse until the short acoustic passage and final chorus.
melody: Use an original flowing chorus phrase over a delicate varied picking pattern.
Use a contrasting original chorus phrase over a warmer varied picking pattern.
lyrical: Develop personal devotion and gratitude into quiet worship.
Develop divine love, trust and spiritual comfort in simple meaningful original words.
